Total number of questions — 20
Entry of Foreign Universities
*361. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a high powered ministerial
panel is on the cards to decide on entry of
foreign universities into the country in the
light of the stringent recommendations
made by an expert committee headed by
noted scientists;
(b) if so, whether this matter is to be
considered by a Group of Ministers before
it is placed before the Cabinet;
(c) if so, by when the panel is likely to
submit its recommendations;
(d) whether Government is also
considering that those universities which
offer some form of joint ventures including
business opportunities should be
entertained; and
(e) if so, by when Government are
likely to take a decision thereon?
National Urban Renewal Mission
†*362. SHRIMATI KUM KUM
RAI:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the cities included under the
Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal
Mission;
(b) the cities where work under the
Mission is already underway;
(c) the amount allocated for the said
project during the current financial year;
and
(d) the status of covering mega cities in
Orissa for development of the
infrastructure with a view to improve the
economy of this backward region?
Sub-standard electric equipments and
sanitary ware in government flats
†*363. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

112
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that in the government flats in
Delhi, sub-standard electric equipments and
sanitarywares have been provided;
(b) the number of complaints of this
nature received during the last six months;
and
(c) the action Government are initiating
against the guilty officers?
Education system and unemployment
†*364. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA: W ill the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the present education system in the
country is creating large scale unemploy-
ment and no priority has been given to the
requirements of the industry and trade;
(b) if so, whether a job oriented
education system is proposed to be
introduced; and
(c) if so, the time limit fixed in this regard
and the details of various aspects which
would be taken care of?
Outflow of IIT graduates to foreign
countries
*365. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plans
to set up IITs in foreign countries;
(b) whether it is a fact that a large number
of IIT graduates migrate immediately after
their studies at IITs;
(c) the extent to which Government are
thinking of encouraging such an outflow of
the students;
(d) whether the high cost of education
at IITs being borne by Government is not
helping the common man; and
(e) if so, the steps Government would
consider to find ways and means to ensure
that IIT students work for the country at
least for some time?
Central University for KBK region
*366. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during a
meeting with him the Chief Minister of
Orissa has made a proposal for setting up a
Central University for the KBK region
(undivided Kalahandi, Bolangir and Koraput
Districts) of Orissa;
(b) whether Government are aware that
a Central University, in this most backward
tribal dominated region, would go a long
way in encouraging higher education among
the tribals where the literacy rate is below
50 per cent;
(c) if so, the status of the proposal; and
(d) the time-frame within which a
Central University would be set up in that
region?
Development of cities
†*367. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
 SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
the number of cities having a population of

Total number of questions — 155
 Setting up Heritage Sites
Commission
2732.  DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
DR. KARAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to set up a Heritage Sites Commission to
ensure conservation of the historical
monuments in the country;
(b) whether this Commission would
have statutory powers and its directions
would be binding on Government, private
groups and individuals;
(c) the number of the monuments in the
country;
(d) the number of monuments destroyed
so far; and
(e) the other objectives of this
Commission and by when it is likely to be
announced?
 Submersion of land in Andaman
Nicobar Islands
2733. SHRI E.M. SUDARSANA
NATCHIAPPAN: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry is initiating a
joint study with Departments of Science
and Technology and Ocean Development
on the Tsunami and its effect of
submersion of lands in Andaman Nicobar
Islands to find out the existence of extended
Tamil Nadu touching Jawa and Sumatra
having Tamil culture and submersion of
land in Ocean due to four Tsunami in
thousands of years ago; and
(b) if not, whether Government would
take up such study to bring cultural
richness of the Indian continent?
 Construction of new museums
2734.  SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have provided

527
assistance to the State Governments for
construction of new museums under the
Centrally sponsored schemes;
(b) if so, the funds provided to Gujarat
during the last three years; and
(c) the number of schemes for which
these funds were provided alongwith the
details of the progress of the schemes?
 Development of world famous sites
2735.  SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have taken a
decision for development of the world
famous sites in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise,
and particularly Uttar Pradesh and Delhi;
(c) the amount expected to be incurred
on each heritage site and by when the work
is expected to be initiated; and
(d) whether the ticket charges would be
increased to see the places and if so, to
what extent and the facilities to be provided
to the tourists?
 National Library for ancient
scripture and Vedic religions
2736.  SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up a National Library for the ancient
scripture and Vedic religions in Uttaranchal
in view of its importance in Himalayan
regions;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when it is likely to be set up?
 Ticket of Qutub Minar
2737.  SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED: Will the Minister of CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cost of
ticket for visiting Qutub Minar is Rs. 10/-
for Indians and Rs. 500/- for foreigners;
and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
 Construction near Protected Heritage
Monuments
2738. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the ASI norms prohibit any
construction within 100 meters from any
Protected Heritage Monuments;
(b) if so, whether any violation of this
rule has been noticed by Government;
(c) whether Government are aware of
the proposed construction of a bridge across
Yamuna near Tuqlakabad in Delhi;
(d) if so, whether the construction is in
full adherence to the rules;
(e) whether opinion of the ASI has been
sought in this regard;
(f) if so, details thereof; and
(g) the details of the measures taken for
safety of the protected monuments?
 Memorial of Colonel William
Lambton
2739.  SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the memorial
to Colonel William Lambton, Surveyor

India is struggling for space;
(b) whether it is a fact that a sprawling

on Nagpur-Hyderabad highway, and there
are no plaques, no boards even outside the
structure; and
(c) if so, the steps  Government propose
to take to prevent the structure?

Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have ensured
that the memorials dedicated to the political
leaders of yore are maintained well;
(b) if so, the funds granted for
